AUTH::unsubscribe
Description
AUTH::unsubscribe
cancels interest in auth query results.
AUTH::response_data
will not return
data from query results for which a subscription has been cancelled
before
AUTH::authenticate
has been
called. Also see
AUTH::subscribe
.
Syntax
AUTH
::
unsubscribe
<
authid
>
AUTH::unsubscribe <authid>
Cancels interest in auth query results.
Examples
The rule below demonstrates how multi-pass auth might be performed.
Additional error checking of the group name would be necessary in a
production-ready rule.

$auth_username

$auth_password
